> In this document, I explain the code for my standard Stan model of the climate-RL task (without confirmation bias) and demonstrate parameter recovery.

# Helper files {.unnumbered}
In this R markdown I use code from the following files: [sim_utils.R](https://gilleslijnzaad.github.io/climate-RL-modeling/all_utils.html#sim_utilsR), [plot_utils.R](https://gilleslijnzaad.github.io/climate-RL-modeling/all_utils.html#plot_utilsR), [fit_utils.R](https://gilleslijnzaad.github.io/climate-RL-modeling/all_utils.html#fit_utilsR), and [utils.R](https://gilleslijnzaad.github.io/climate-RL-modeling/all_utils.html#utilsR).

# Creating the data

--- 

## Running the simulation
```{r create-data, comment = NA}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/research/climate-RL-mod/2_modeling_showcase")
main_dir <- "~/research/climate-RL-mod/"
util_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "9_utilities/")
mod_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "0_models/")
model_path <- paste0(mod_dir, "1_std.stan")

sim <- new.env()
source(paste0(mod_dir, "1_std.R"), local = sim)
params <- list(
  n_part = 50,
  n_trials = 30,
  LR_group = 0.4,
  inv_temp_group = 0.5,
  initQ_dev_group = 2,
  mu_R_group = 5.5,
  sigma_R_group = 2
)

sim_dat <- sim$run(params)

cat(paste0("PARAMETER SETTINGS:"), capture.output(dplyr::glimpse(params)), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0("SIMULATED DATA:"), capture.output(dplyr::glimpse(sim_dat)), sep = "\n")
```

## Inspecting the data
Just so I know what to expect of our model, I include plots of the simulated data: Q and choices over time.

```{r inspecting-data, fig.height = 4}
plot <- new.env()
source(paste0(util_dir, "plot_utils.R"), local = plot)

plot$sim_plots(sim_dat, params)
```

# Explaining the model

--- 

I show the Stan model code bit by bit to explain what is happening. The full code can be found in `1_std.stan`.

## `data` block
The data we supply to the model consist of:

1. the number of participants: `n_part`;
1. the number of trials per participant: `n_trials`;
1. an array of choices that a participant made: `choice_c[n_part, n_trials]`, coded as (1) consistent with the very first choice (hence `choice_c`) or (2) not consistent with the first choice;
1. an array of ratings that a participant gave: `R[n_part, n_trials]`. These are analogous to the array `outcomes[n_trials]` in the `2arm_bandit_example` (see [Stan code](https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/blob/develop/commons/stan_files/bandit2arm_delta.stan) for this example);
1. the mean rating of a participant, as calculated from the data: `mu_R[n_part]`.

```{r explmod-data, comment = NA}
mod_code <- readLines(model_path)
start <- grep("data \\{", mod_code)[1]
end <- grep("transformed data \\{", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
```

## `transformed data` block
Currently unused.
```{r explmod-transf-data, eval = FALSE, comment = NA}
start <- grep("transformed data \\{", mod_code)
end <- grep("parameters \\{", mod_code)[1] - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
```

## `parameters` block
In the current model, we have three free parameters:

1. learning rate `LR`;
1. inverse temperature `inv_temp`;
1. deviation from the mean for initial Q: `initQ_dev`. This is related to the actual initial Qs as: 

  > `initQ_pref = mu_R + initQ_dev`
  > `initQ_nonpref = mu_R - initQ_dev`

  where `mu_R` is calculated from the data.

```{r explmod-params, comment = NA}

end <- grep("transformed parameters \\{", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
```

# Fitting the model

--- 

## Single run: chosen parameters
### Do the run

```{r run-model}
dat_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "3_param_recovery/1_std/1_run/")
dat_file <- paste0(dat_dir, "dat_001.json")

fitting <- new.env()
source(paste0(util_dir, "fit_utils.R"), local = fitting)
model <- cmdstan_model(model_path)
free_params_group <- c("LR_group", "inv_temp_group", "initQ_dev_group")
draws <- fitting$fit(model, dat_file, return = "draws", free_params = free_params_group, show_iteration_progress = TRUE)
saveRDS(draws, paste0(dat_dir, "draws.rds"))
```

### Group-level parameters
```{r posterior-plots}
draws <- readRDS(paste0(dat_dir, "draws.rds"))
p <- plot$posterior_densities(draws, free_params_group, params)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(p)
```
```{r posterior-table}
util <- new.env()
source(paste0(util_dir, "utils.R"), local = util)
to_inspect <- free_params_group
util$print_posterior_table(draws, params, to_inspect)
```

### Participant-level parameters
```{r sim-vs-fit}
participant_params <- rjson::fromJSON(file = paste0(dat_dir, "param_settings_001.json"))
free_params_pp <- gsub("_group", "", free_params_group)
plot$pp_level_param_fit(draws, free_params_pp, participant_params)
```
